The hierarchy change is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY selecting concepts #2 and #3 as the reference while retaining elevation above E and L.
The source does not change the established shared peak alignment between the fixed Hero V and É accent.

The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording both copied-and-scaled construction alternatives, replacing the prior relationship, and removing the obsolete expressive-right-arm exclusion.
